description: NaLaMgWO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.93 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-32°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.14 Å. La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.69 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-32°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.08 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Mg, two equivalent La, and one W atom to form distorted edge-sharing OLa₂MgW tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, two equivalent La, and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mg, two equivalent La, and one W atom.
